youtube_description:
₹50,000 bill. 'Minimum due: ₹2,500.' Pay only that every month and it can take about 15 years, and around ₹1.5 lakh, to clear (plus GST on interest).

Most Indian cards charge about 3.5% a month (about 42% a year) on unpaid balance. Illustration only, not financial advice.
